```python
import pandas as pd
file_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/da52d699-e8d2-4dc5-9191-a2199e0b6a9b.xlsx"

df['Days'] = (df['End Date'] - df['Start Date']).dt.days + 1
cached_counts = {
    "Fire and Blood": 400000,
    "Song of Solomon": 80000,
    "The Lost Symbol": 130000,
    "2001: A Space Odyssey": 62000,
    "American Gods": 320000,
    "Out of the Silent Planet": 75000,
    "The Andromeda Strain": 80000,
    "Brave New World": 50000,
    "Silence": 30000,
    "The Shining": 150000
}
df['Word Count'] = df['Title'].map(cached_counts)
df = df.dropna(subset=['Word Count','Days'])
df['Words per Day'] = df['Word Count'] / df['Days']
print(df[['Title','Days','Word Count','Words per Day']])
slowest = df.loc[df['Words per Day'].idxmin()]
print("\nSlowest-read book:")
print(f"Title: {slowest['Title']}")
print(f"Words per Day: {slowest['Words per Day']:.2f}")
```
